name: Slow cinematic
summary: Seven long shots of one person: a flash-in close, cuts on matching action, an eased hard-edge wipe between two wides, and a fade to black on a closing wide.

slots.query: person chest-up on a long lens, soft background, raises hands toward the face at the end
the same person tiny in a big wide, arms out, others walk in, ends with a run at the lens
backlit ridge or slope with tiny figures, then the person steps into profile
fog or haze with one person, a second walks in, medium two-shot
long-lens silhouette of the person against a lit landscape
high wide or drone view of the landscape with the person small on a path
locked-off wide of friends resting at a viewpoint as the light falls
